name: StandardFirmata
desc: Lets Pinscope's Firmata mode control every pin from the phone.

name: Blink
desc: Blinks the on-board LED on pin 13 once a second.

name: Fade
desc: Fades an LED on PWM pin 9 up and down.

name: Analog read
desc: Prints A0's reading and voltage; open the plotter to graph it.

name: Plotter demo
desc: Sends three labelled waves. No wiring needed.

name: Button and LED
desc: A button on pin 2 lights the on-board LED and reports presses.

name: Servo sweep
desc: Sweeps an SG90 servo on pin 9.

name: Signal generator
desc: Square wave on pin 11 (1 Hz–100 kHz), PWM on pin 9, and sine/triangle/sawtooth on pin 6, set from the serial monitor. For a bench oscilloscope.

name: RC charging
desc: Charges a 10 µF capacitor through 1 kΩ from pin 8 and plots the curve against the 10 ms time constant.

name: Button bounce
desc: Counts the edges one press of a button on pin 2 makes, showing contact bounce.

name: Light meter
desc: Plots a photoresistor on A0 as a percentage.

name: Distance
desc: HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor on pins 12 and 11, plotted in centimetres.
